subject: Require ownership or `CAP_SYS_NICE` to lower a process's priority
notes: One commit holding both the kernel fix and the pool edit. Staged the four paths explicitly; git status in the worktree shows only the untracked .osdk/ build directory, and test/initramfs/src/regression/ has no leftover repro file.
